title: Filing an appeal
description: appeal against an order passed by the Central Authority

steps.step: receipt of the order passed by the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21
filing an appeal to the National Commission within thirty days
order is passed under sub-section (1) of section 72
appeal is filed against the order
The appellant receives the order of a District Commission or a State Commission or the National Commission
The appellant files an appeal within thirty days from the date of the order
If the appeal is filed after thirty days, the appellant must show sufficient cause for the delay
